findings.title: Bind the S36 resolution action type before COMMIT_READY
findings.body: _progress_sources verifies S36 manifest, policy, parameter hash, query basis and coverage, but never checks r["action_type"]. Changing only that immutable resolution input to another action type leaves every checked binding valid and permits VALIDATING→COMMIT_READY with evidence for the wrong action. Frozen DB S36 requires action/manifest/policy binding and packet requires coherent source-bound S36/S37. Derive the exact action type from the authoritative current TEST action/policy basis, include it in the verified resolution/query basis, and add a self-consistent wrong-action-type DC denial asserting unchanged stage/receipt/event/outbox state.

findings.title: Persist the trusted post-lock guard acceptance time in progress events
findings.body: prepare_planning_progress obtains fresh clock_timestamp() after locks, but the sampled now is not carried into the progress event. idempotent_outcome inserts S03 without typed_payload or any explicit accepted timestamp; domain_events.recorded_at defaults to transaction_timestamp() in the frozen baseline migration, so a transaction that waited can record its pre-wait start time rather than accepted guard time. Frozen DB §4.3 explicitly requires guard acceptance time in the event. Persist the exact server-owned sampled acceptance time through bounded progress bookkeeping without caller clock authority or public owner-grant changes; add real-PG positive lock-wait and replay assertions showing the stored timestamp follows lock release and remains immutable.
